name: What is a roof replacement readiness assessment?

mainEntity.name: What is a roof replacement readiness assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: A roof replacement readiness assessment is a comprehensive inspection of your existing roof to determine its current condition, identify any damage or weaknesses, and evaluate if a full replacement is necessary. This assessment helps determine the scope of work, material options, and potential challenges before beginning a project. It also provides insights into the remaining lifespan of your roof and helps you plan for future roofing needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's an inspection to assess your roof's condition, identify damage, and determine if replacement is necessary.
